topic: Changes in accounting policies, estimates and errors
question: Distinguish between a change in accounting policy, a change in accounting estimate and a prior period error under Ind AS 8, and explain how each is accounted for.
sources: Ind AS 8 Accounting Policies, Changes in Accounting Estimates and Errors (as amended by the Companies (Indian Accounting Standards) Amendment Rules, 2023)

points.label: When a policy may change
points.description: An entity changes an accounting policy only if an Ind AS requires it or if the change gives reliable and more relevant information.
points.basis: Ind AS 8, conditions for changing an accounting policy

points.label: Accounting for a policy change
points.description: A voluntary change is applied retrospectively by adjusting opening equity of the earliest period presented and restating comparatives, unless impracticable; a change from a new Ind AS follows its transitional provisions.
points.basis: Ind AS 8, applying changes in accounting policies

points.label: Change in accounting estimate
points.description: Accounting estimates are monetary amounts subject to measurement uncertainty (for example useful lives or expected credit losses); a change is applied prospectively in the current period and future periods if both are affected. If it is unclear whether a change is in policy or estimate, it is treated as a change in estimate.
points.basis: Ind AS 8, definition of accounting estimates and accounting for changes in estimates

points.label: Prior period errors
points.description: Omissions or misstatements in past financial statements from failing to use, or misusing, reliable information that was available, such as mistakes, oversight of facts or fraud.
points.basis: Ind AS 8, definition of prior period errors

points.label: Correcting errors and disclosure
points.description: Material errors are corrected retrospectively in the first financial statements approved after discovery, by restating comparatives (or opening balances of the earliest period presented), unless impracticable; the nature and effect of each change or correction is disclosed.
points.basis: Ind AS 8, correction of prior period errors and disclosures
